/* Generated by build-offline-worker.mjs. Only static, same-origin files are cached. */
const CACHE_NAME = "noteflare-shell-__CACHE_VERSION__";
const SHELL_ASSETS = __SHELL_ASSETS__;
const SHELL_ASSET_SET = new Set(SHELL_ASSETS);
let retired = false;

function mimeType(response) {
  return response.headers.get("content-type")?.split(";", 1)[0]?.trim().toLowerCase() ?? "";
}

function validStaticResponse(path, response) {
  if (response.status !== 200 || response.redirected) return false;
  const type = mimeType(response);
  if (path === "/") return type === "text/html";
  if (path.endsWith(".js")) return type.includes("javascript");
  if (path.endsWith(".css")) return type === "text/css";
  if (/\.woff2?$/.test(path)) return type.includes("woff") || type === "application/octet-stream";
  if (path.endsWith(".webmanifest")) return type.includes("json") || type === "application/manifest+json";
  if (/\.(?:png|jpg|ico)$/.test(path)) return type.startsWith("image/");
  return false;
}

async function retireIfWorkerWasRemoved() {
  try {
    const response = await fetch("/sw.js", { cache: "no-store", redirect: "manual" });
    const type = mimeType(response);
    if (response.ok && type?.includes("javascript")) return;
    const removed = response.status === 404 ||
      (response.ok && type === "text/html" && /<div\s+id=["']root["']/.test(await response.text()));
    if (removed) {
      retired = true;
      await self.registration.unregister();
      const keys = await caches.keys();
      await Promise.all(keys.filter((key) => key.startsWith("noteflare-shell-")).map((key) => caches.delete(key)));
    }
  } catch {
    // An outage is not a rollback; keep the offline shell.
  }
}

self.addEventListener("install", (event) => {
  event.waitUntil((async () => {
    const cache = await caches.open(CACHE_NAME);
    try {
      let next = 0;
      await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: 6 }, async () => {
        while (next < SHELL_ASSETS.length) {
          const path = SHELL_ASSETS[next++];
          const response = await fetch(path, { cache: path.startsWith("/assets/") ? "default" : "reload" });
          if (!validStaticResponse(path, response)) throw new Error(`Invalid offline shell asset: ${path}`);
          await cache.put(path, response);
        }
      }));
    } catch (error) {
      await caches.delete(CACHE_NAME);
      throw error;
    }
  })());
});

self.addEventListener("activate", (event) => {
  event.waitUntil(
    Promise.all([
      caches.keys().then((keys) =>
        Promise.all(
          keys
            .filter((key) => key.startsWith("noteflare-shell-") && key !== CACHE_NAME)
            .map((key) => caches.delete(key)),
        ),
      ),
      self.clients.claim(),
    ]),
  );
});

self.addEventListener("fetch", (event) => {
  const request = event.request;
  if (request.method !== "GET") return;
  const url = new URL(request.url);
  if (url.origin !== self.location.origin) return;
  if (retired) return;

  if (request.mode === "navigate" && (url.pathname === "/" || url.pathname === "/index.html")) {
    event.waitUntil(retireIfWorkerWasRemoved());
    event.respondWith((async () => {
      const controller = new AbortController();
      const timeout = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), 5_000);
      try {
        const response = await fetch(request, { signal: controller.signal });
        if (response.status < 500 && response.status !== 511) return response;
      } catch {
        // Use the matching cached shell when the network cannot open the app.
      } finally {
        clearTimeout(timeout);
      }
      return (await (await caches.open(CACHE_NAME)).match("/")) ?? Response.error();
    })());
    return;
  }

  if (SHELL_ASSET_SET.has(url.pathname) && !url.pathname.startsWith("/assets/")) {
    event.respondWith(fetch(request).catch(async () =>
      (await (await caches.open(CACHE_NAME)).match(url.pathname)) ?? Response.error(),
    ));
    return;
  }

  if (url.pathname.startsWith("/assets/")) {
    const response = (async () => {
      try {
        const saved = await (await caches.open(CACHE_NAME)).match(url.pathname);
        if (saved) return { response: saved, copy: null };
      } catch {
        // Cache access is optional while the network is available.
      }
      const fresh = await fetch(request);
      return {
        response: fresh,
        copy: !retired && validStaticResponse(url.pathname, fresh) ? fresh.clone() : null,
      };
    })();
    event.respondWith(response.then(({ response: result }) => result));
    event.waitUntil(response.then(async ({ copy }) => {
      if (!copy || retired) return;
      try {
        await (await caches.open(CACHE_NAME)).put(url.pathname, copy);
      } catch {
        // A full or unavailable cache must not break a successful asset fetch.
      }
    }).catch(() => {}));
  }
});
